name: Arcane Mayhem
description:
About This Game

Arcane Mayhem is a fast-paced action roguelike packed with chaotic spell‑slinging combat. Unleash devastating magic, fuse elemental reactions, and carve through relentless swarms of monsters to prove your worth as a rising wizard. Build a deadly Loadout, grow your ever-expanding spellbook, and collect items and buffs to help you on your way.

YOUR ARSENAL

  • Fill your spellbook: Collect unique Spellcards throughout your runs to expand your collection.

  • Choose your loadout: Transform your playstyle by switching Loadouts, which define your spell slots, starting attributes, and unique innate traits. Equip any combination of spells that suits your style, and instantly test them in the playground before entering a real run.

  • Gain Mastery: Using spells earns Mastery XP. Unlock new spells by mastering existing ones.

PROGRESSION

Play the game and earn XP to level up and unlock rewards like spells, artifacts, and cosmetic items. Collect Arcane Crystals to permanently unlock new spells, artifacts, and loadouts.

CONQUER THE REGIONS

Fight through waves of enemies across multiple regions, each ending in a battle against its boss.

  • Artifacts & Shards: Find powerful Artifacts that reshape your mechanics, or stack Stat Shards to boost Agility, Critical Power, Spell Haste, Vitality, and more.

  • Tactical Drafting: You’re never locked to a single spell loadout. Swap spells mid‑run to handle new threats and visit the Shop for key upgrades.

  • Status Effect Synergy: Mix Fire, Frost, and Lightning to unleash powerful elemental reactions.

PLANNED FEATURES

Arcane Mayhem is in active development. Coming soon:

  • Mayhem Levels: Push your skills to the limit with difficulty modifiers for increased challenge and rewards.

  • Challenges: Beat gameplay challenges to unlock new artifacts and cosmetic items.

  • New Content: New regions, enemies, artifacts, spells, loadouts, challenges and more!
short_desc: Master the arcane in this fast-paced action roguelike. Grow your spellbook, draft your loadout, and trigger chaotic elemental reactions as you blast through relentless waves of enemies.
